text: Sorry this is going to be long I'm so tired I can barely see the screen. I childmind and I've got a 14 month old boy overnight while his mum's away for work. His temp is 39.2, I've checked it a few times this evening. He just will not settle tonight, every time I put him down he's up again grizzling, but honestly apart from that hes himself, he's been eating his snacks and playing with the stacking cups and giving me big smiles. I mention it because I know you'll ask about rashes. He's got some red spots on his arms and the back of his legs but we were out in the garden all day and the mosquitos were awful, theyre the little raised itchy bumps, I've got the exact same ones all up my arms and so has my own daughter. They came up this afternoon after we came in. I just dont know if the temp on its own is something I should be doing more about or if I just keep going like this till morning. I've not slept properly in two nights so I'm second guessing everything
